rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance – annual rent increase cap
rules.requirement: Residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% per year or 80% of the percent change in CPI over the most recent 12-month period; if CPI is negative, no increase is permitted. Owners may petition the City for relief to obtain a fair and reasonable return.
rules.key_value: Lower of 3% or 80% of CPI change; 0% if CPI negative
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.

effective_dates.quoted_span: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.

exemption_conditions.condition: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995 are exempt from the rent cap
Mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990 are exempt from the rent cap
exemption_conditions.value: mobile home space first offered for rent after 1990-01-01

coverage.notes: Covered residential buildings must be constructed on or before February 1, 1995; mobile home spaces must have been offered for rent on or before January 1, 1990. Allowable increase published by June 30 each year, effective September 1.

rules.coverage_text: Residential rental property and mobile home spaces in Santa Ana.
rules.exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, and mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, an owner may not terminate a tenancy without an at-fault or no-fault just cause stated in a written notice, and must first give a notice to cure violations. For no-fault terminations, the owner must provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive the final 3 months of rent.
rules.key_value: Just cause required after 30 days; 3 months' relocation assistance or rent waiver for no-fault
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.

effective_dates.quoted_span: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.

exemption_conditions.condition: Housing produced in the last 15 years is exempt
exemption_conditions.value: housing produced in the last 15 years

exemption_conditions.condition: Deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel and transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters are exempt

rules.coverage_text: Residential tenancies in Santa Ana after 30 days of occupancy.
rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
